message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel empirical CDF chart comparing evolved-minus-initial skill line counts for pass and fail outcomes under Refine and Repair.","description":"Two side-by-side step charts show ECDF (vertical axis, 0 to 1) against Δ lines (evolved − initial) on a symmetric logarithmic horizontal scale, linear for |Δ| ≤ 50. The left panel is Refine (n=43): solid blue is Opus pass (n=39), and dashed red is Opus fail (n=4). The blue pass curve has a long negative tail, extending to roughly −6,000 lines, then rises sharply around zero and positive values. The red fail curve has only a few large steps: it is around 0.25 over part of the negative range, around 0.75 through much of the positive range, and reaches 1. The right panel is Repair (n=46): solid blue is Opus pass (n=28), and dashed red is Opus fail (n=18). Both curves extend into negative values and rise steeply near zero; they broadly track one another, with the fail curve somewhat higher over portions of the negative range and the two close through much of the central and positive range. In both panels a dotted vertical line marks Δ=0. The horizontal axes show ticks at approximately −10⁴, −10³, −10², −10¹, 0, 10¹, and 10²; the vertical axes are labelled ECDF. No arrows or check/cross marks are shown.
